::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 12th 1897  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Winchester City Council, Historic Resources Centre, LH3801
:::

Dear Sir
In answer to your enquiries I beg to state that I believe my first publication was about the year 1846.[^1]  I edited the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) from its commencement in 1851 till 1893.  I have never resided anywhere but in this village

I remain &c
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: In fact *Abbeychurch* had appeared in 1844.
